type_name: Certified efficient IT and end-user equipment
definition: IT or end-user equipment explicitly required to meet an energy-efficiency certification or standard. Generic certification without an energy requirement is insufficient.
Network technology, architecture or operating modes explicitly selected to reduce energy use. Replacement may also qualify when existing technology is displaced.
Whole-facility design or performance requirements explicitly addressing energy efficiency, including data-centre energy targets. Generic green certification alone is insufficient.
Cooling equipment or design explicitly intended to reduce energy use. Heat protection may separately qualify when a hazard-protection function is stated.
Monitoring or control systems explicitly used to reduce energy consumption. Metering alone without an efficiency function is insufficient.
Replaces existing technology explicitly to reduce energy use. Equipment or network-efficiency types may also qualify when supported.
